abstract:
We present Galaxy Image Analysis, a software suite for web-based analysis of high-content and high-throughput cell microscopy image data. Galaxy Image Analysis builds upon the Galaxy platform, an open-source scientific workflow management system, which enables upscaling workflows, collaborative data analysis, and reproducible science. While Galaxy was originally developed for analyzing genomic sequencing data, we have extended the Galaxy ecosystem by developing tools and workflows for different image analysis tasks.
Galaxy Image Analysis has a web-based graphical user interface, is user-friendly, and well-suited for non-experts and cloud environments. The developed web-based software provides a wide spectrum of tools for microscopy image analysis, which can be combined to build more powerful automated workflows. The tools and workflows comprise image enhancement, cell segmentation, cell counting, feature extraction, image registration, and visualization. Tools for validation and performance evaluation are also included. The software was successfully applied for analyzing cell microscopy images in different biological applications. Use cases of image analysis tools and workflows are presented. We also performed a quantitative evaluation including a comparison with other tools.
The web-based software suite Galaxy Image Analysis has a high level of user adoption. The software is open-source and publicly available. Galaxy Image Analysis is an important bioinformatics resource for researchers in the life sciences.
